craft_notes: Sthāyin: utterance-joy. Close: mark. Rejected: 'instantly' — 'at once' kept; 'mudrā' dropped — kept? L4 'seal-host' — kept.

lines: At its right speaking, the great seal-host of spell
comes face to face at once, by body-possession's sign.
l4.sanskrit_cite: asyoccāre kṛte samyaṅ mantramudrāgaṇo mahān | sadyaḥ sanmukhatām eti svadehāveśalakṣaṇam

reads_against.argmap: Rightly uttered, the great host goes face to face at once, body-possession-marked.
c1_essence: Right utterance: host face to face, body-possession-marked.
